description: The full message: sender, subject, plain text, HTML and any attachments. This is where a confirmation code or a sign-in link will be. Read `text`: when the sender shipped HTML only, as most transactional mail does, it holds a plain-text rendering of that HTML rather than nothing, with link targets and image alt text kept.

id.description: The message id from list_messages or wait_for_message.

name: read_message
title: Read one message
